sections.title: Submission readiness
sections.sql: select name,customer,owner,due,status,questions,approved,blocked,decision from bid_readiness order by due

sections.title: Work allocation
sections.sql: select * from workload order by unfinished desc

sections.title: Answers needing review
sections.sql: select title,owner,review_due,reason from review_queue order by review_due

sections.title: Current responses
sections.sql: select bid,section,question,owner,answer,source,state from response_queue order by bid,section,question
